title: Source Route Cards Batch 001
mission: Feed the source-vault and tracker system with first public source routes for the power architecture targets.
boundary: A source route card shows where to pull records. It does not prove the contents of those records until a verified card is created.

cards.recordToPull: Latest annual report and risk factor sections.
cards.whatItCanShow: Business segments, risk disclosures, public filings, governance disclosures and executive/control context.
cards.whatItCannotShow: Private intent, unlawful conduct or undisclosed arrangements beyond the filing.
cards.nextAction: Create VRC card for Tesla annual report route.

cards.recordToPull: Latest Oracle annual report, cloud, health and public-sector risk sections.
cards.whatItCanShow: Database/cloud business, health-system exposure, filings and risk disclosures.
cards.whatItCannotShow: Unproven misuse or undisclosed government activity.
cards.nextAction: Create VRC card for Oracle filing route.
